items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: The interviewer states 'I run around with him' and 'I know him well', while the interviewee only confirms the age and asks 'He's dead?' without indicating personal interaction.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear the name Albino Red?

I run around with him, still in Missouri, Arkansas, Memphis, me and him running down the road. Albino Red, yeah, he can work with it. Albino Red ought to be about 74 years old right now tomorrow. 74? Yeah, he ought to be.
